citation: CIMM. SWMM5+ beta source and alpha technical report. https://doi.org/10.18738/T8/WQZ5EX
description: SWMM5+ is a public beta of a successor stormwater-management simulation engine. Its repository publishes source code and a compilation guide, with a technical report for the earlier alpha version. Inputs are urban drainage networks, land runoff and event forcing; outputs are simulated hydraulic and hydrological states for pipes, channels and related stormwater components. Spatial extent and simulation period follow the configured system. The README states that the beta source is in the public domain. A limitation is that beta documentation is still being developed and parts of the alpha report are obsolete, so users must check the installation guide and current source before relying on an older description. SWMM5+ is related to EPA SWMM (model-epa-swmm) but is a distinct code line and should not silently inherit the older model's validation. It can support stormwater capacity and flooding studies. The installation guide was identified as documentation; no compiler, model package or PDF was downloaded.
inputs: Drainage network, catchment and rainfall/event specifications
